title: Sorbitol: what it means for your plan
standfirst: Which of our plan rules this ingredient turns on, and what that does not tell you.

spans.text: Our scorer looks for sorbitol when Low-FODMAP is on for you. If that plan is off, your score does not change. This is how the app reads a label. It is not a claim about health.
Labels do not all use the same word for this. Below is every spelling we watch for. Some come from other languages, because a pack made for another country prints its own.
One word on a label can cover more than one thing. A plan may also turn on how much is in the food, which this page cannot see. Read the pack when it matters.
